title: Training Files Outside Authorized Directories
description: On the Training Workbench, opening run artifacts from the Artifacts column can fail with the toast `Source link path is outside the configured allowed source roots.` The shared screenshot shows the page using transcript/export/run directories and a harness script outside the repo root, while artifact open still routes through the generic source-link guard that only trusts configured source roots by default. Expected behavior: when local open-with-default-app is enabled, the Training Workbench should allow opening files under its resolved training transcript/export/run/harness directories without requiring operators to weaken the global source-link policy for unrelated paths.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Expanded from the shared screenshot and local code review. The warning originates from `VarResolver` source-root authorization, but the clicked artifact belongs to the Training Workbench's configured training directories rather than wiki source-link roots. The scoped fix is to authorize artifact open against the page's resolved training directories instead of broadening global source-link access.
